transcript: The German officer walked into the icy seawater and took out his watch to time it. In just 10 short seconds, he had to get out of the cold water. Then, he made a prisoner of war stand in the freezing water. And within seconds, the prisoner lost consciousness. The German officer got sick from the icy water. Believing the earlier escaped prisoner who'd fled into the icy seawater was dead, he changed the number of dead prisoners from 11 to 12. A few days later, a Norwegian on skis burst into the base. him. The Norwegian put it on and left quickly. Soon, the officer realized he was the escaped prisoner. The officer immediately took off in an F-22 fighter jet to pursue. The escaped prisoner, spotting the jet, fled desperately. The officer aimed at him fired. The bombing by the jet triggered an avalanche. The escaped prisoner was buried in the snow. This time, the officer ordered that they must find the escaped prisoner's body.
